scenarios.title: CNT-style iterative human-in-the-loop research
scenarios.goal: Prove that AIRA can plan a Protocol step, wait for a real Record, consume the validated result, and continue or finish without relabeling model output as experimental evidence.

scenarios.title: Fermentation multi-source data integration
scenarios.goal: Prove that literature, inventory, instrument, human, service, and compute outputs remain typed and traceable while a human-finalized Result Package integrates the evidence.

scenarios.title: Protein-purification method evolution
scenarios.goal: Prove that reviewed Knowledge and validated experimental Evidence can support a reviewable Protocol improvement against one pinned base version, and that stale or already-applied proposals fail closed.

scenarios.title: OT-2 governed instrument control
scenarios.goal: Prove that an OT-2-style liquid-handling sequence remains booking-bound, command-pinned, step-bounded, interlock-gated, non-retrying, and paused for human review before each later high-risk physical command.
